name: CPQExam
intro: CPQExam 是 QuarkMed 基于中国卫生专业技术资格考试整理并公开的 7,600 道中文选择题，覆盖初级、中级、副高、高级四级和 14 个科室。官方协议要求模型思考后仅返回 JSON 答案，再经 JSON/正则解析、答案规范化和精确匹配，按级别、题型与科室报告准确率。
build_method: 中国卫生专业技术资格考试整理；原始采样过滤未披露；官方发布7,600条JSONL
task_type: 医学考试, 单选与多选问答
eval_feature: 四个专业级别, 14个科室, JSON/正则解析, 多选排序, 精确匹配
task_type_en: Medical examination, single- and multiple-response QA
build_method_en: Curated from the Chinese Health Professional Qualification Examination; original sampling/filtering undisclosed; official 7,600-item JSONL release
eval_feature_en: Four professional levels, 14 departments, JSON/regex parsing, multiple-answer sorting, exact match
intro_en: CPQExam is a 7,600-question Chinese multiple-choice benchmark curated by QuarkMed from the Chinese Health Professional Qualification Examination and released publicly. It spans primary, intermediate, associate-senior, and senior levels across 14 departments. The official protocol asks the model to think and return JSON only, then applies JSON/regex parsing, answer normalization, and exact matching to report accuracy by level, question type, and department.
scale_en: 7,600 questions (600 primary, 4,800 intermediate, 1,200 associate senior, 1,000 senior)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with QuarkMed Technical Report arXiv:2508.11894 Sections 4.1–4.3 and Table 7, the official 7,600-line quarkmed_cpqexam.jsonl release, and the official evaluation README/evaluate.py. CPQExam comes from the Chinese Health Professional Qualification Examination and focuses on practical application and case analysis. The paper calls it private, while the repository later releases 7,600 questions across 14 departments: 600 primary, 4,800 intermediate, 1,200 associate-senior, and 1,000 senior. The release includes single-response, multiple-response, shared-stem, and case-analysis forms. Neither paper nor repository discloses original sampling, filtering, deduplication, or release-selection rules, so the diagram preserves that boundary. Evaluation uses one inference per item at temperature 0.6 and a standardized Chinese prompt requiring JSON-only {answer: ...}; the parser tries JSON, falls back to regex, converts invalid output to empty, removes separators/whitespace, sorts multiple-answer letters, and exact-matches the gold answer. The script reports Accuracy by professional level, question form, and department plus invalid count. Table 7 separately marks QuarkMed results with optional knowledge augmentation.
